title: Intermittent connection loss with Dexcom G6
symptom: The connection between xDrip on a Soyes 7S phone and the Dexcom G6 drops intermittently. After some time, xDrip can't connect to the G6 anymore and shows Signal Missed until Bluetooth is manually turned off and on or the phone is rebooted.
evidence_quote: the connection between xDrip on the Soyes 7S and the G6 drops intermittently. When the Soyes 7S and the G6 are connected, xDrip works great. But eventually, after some time (can be 10 minutes or hours), xDrip can't connect to the G6 anymore and shows Signal Missed until I manually turn Bluetooth OFF and ON or reboot the phone.
